title: Load a paint roller evenly on a ribbed tray
instruction: Load the paint roller evenly. Roll it through the well and over the ribbed ramp to remove excess paint. Leave it on the tray's flat rest.
context: Roll a mini sleeve through the paint well and over the ribbed ramp to prepare it for use.
setup: A 100 mm roller axle rests at (324, -225, 22) mm with the handle angled up 22 degrees. The tray origin is (345, -47) mm with a 157 mm well, 150 mm ramp and a raised parking pocket. Coordinates are relative to the tabletop.
scoring: 0.20 per band with at least 10 of 12 sectors wetted by rolling contact. Final 0.20 for all bands covered, 69 mm or more of ramp rolling after coating, and 5 s released on the rest. The center and frame must remain within 2 mm and 3 degrees of their pose at the start of that hold.
reset_notes: Restore the authored pose and joints. Clear trial history and visual state. Use seed 0 and zero object jitter.
fidelity: An independent sleeve joint drives the contact-based coverage estimate. Rotation over the ramp models removal of excess. A physical pilot must calibrate coverage and drip checks.
